user_query: I want to explore different surf destinations around the world. Could you provide me with a list of countries with surf breaks and their corresponding surf forecasts? It would be great to have detailed forecasts for specific surf breaks as well.

TaskList.description: Gather a comprehensive list of countries known for having surf breaks.
Retrieve surf break information for each country identified in step 1, including location details.
Fetch surf forecasts for each surf break obtained in step 2, detailing wave height, swell direction, and conditions.
required_inputs: list of surf breaks from step 2

TaskList.description: Compile and format the information into a clear list of countries with their surf breaks and corresponding surf forecasts.
